name: Miske (Hungary)
description: A vertical white banner with a narrow blue stripe along each side edge, charged near the top with the municipal arms of Miske: a blue shield with a yellow charge, with a helm, red and blue mantling and a scroll inscribed MISKE.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Miske arms with helm, mantling and scroll
